evidence.R1-01: round0 line 1525 defines OrderNotCancelled as 'the order is not cancelled', yet CO-S17 row 3 (line 1037) has it arrive after CO-A2 returned cancelled and the row 103 handling ('tell the customer the order is cancelled, the refund has not been issued') rests only on packet line 83 'issue_refund adds outcome OrderNotCancelled', which gives no handling.
evidence.R1-02: Packet line 64 'If the cancel call times out: no blind resend; re-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund' covers any cancel timeout; round0 row 101 makes no lookup and bans CO-A3 after the second timeout.
evidence.R1-03: Packet line 63 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet' vs round0 row 105 'the refund has not been issued', enforced in CO-S20 by 'Refund not issued reported' (line 1505).
evidence.R1-04: 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' appears only in Scope (round0 line 49); no CO/G rule and no §5.2 dimension (lines 1497-1509) checks it.
evidence.R1-05: CO-08 (round0 line 83) requires only telling the refund id; success scenarios use only 'Refund id reported' (line 1497); nothing asserts the agent says the order is cancelled or the refund status.
evidence.R1-06: Row 96 covers a change 'in the confirming turn or after confirming'; the only change scenario CO-S03 has Turn 2 'in place of a confirmation' (line 248), so no scenario triggers the row's condition.
evidence.R1-08: CO-S19/S20/S21 Initial state 'together they create refund RF-5531' (lines 1120, 1177, 1236) leaves open what a CO-A1 between the two calls returns, while Appendix A says 'A timeout creates the refund or not as Initial state says'.
evidence.R1-10: CO-S03/S04 Turn 2 trigger 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482 and asks to go ahead' is not a §5.1 event; evaluation-checklist.md line 39 requires 'names an event §5.1 defines ... never "a proposal"'.
evidence.R1-11: Dimension (round0 line 1498) requires 'was not cancelled' while CO-S05 Unambiguity note (line 395) and CO-01 use 'cannot be cancelled'; evaluation-checklist.md line 52 requires one definition that holds in every user scenario.
evidence.R1-12: Dimension line 1502 requires telling 'the refund is the order's total paid'; CO-S09 trajectory step 3 (line 594) only states $86.40 inside the proposal, and nothing says whether that counts.
evidence.R1-13: 'Orders unavailable reported' (line 1503) requires 'proposes no cancellation' and no section defines 'proposal'; the CO-S10 instance stands though the CO-S07/S08 instances change no verdict.
evidence.R1-16: Appendix A CO-A3 row (line 1525) adds failure_reason, absent from the confirmed refund model (packet lines 38, 46) and from the row's own return shape {refund_id, amount, payment_method, status}.
evidence.R1-17: Appendix A says 'Proposed in round 1' (line 1515); packet lines 25-32 name no tools and lines 75-85 show tools proposed in the tool confirmation turn.
evidence.R1-18: No round0 scenario has a no-number request with one open order (CO-S01 rows all name the order, lines 155-157), and CO-S09 rows (587-589) never ask for a different amount.
evidence.R2-02: CO-09 is [minimal guarantee], but at round 2 its no-date clause sat only in 'Cancellation and refund reported' (success scenarios); failure-path dimensions such as round0 line 1505 lacked it (added only in the final spec, line 1717).
evidence.R2-05: 'Refund not confirmed reported' required 'the refund is not confirmed yet' with no list of accepted forms, while CO-S20 row 1's lookup shows the refund failed; the final spec (line 1718) had to add '(saying it is not confirmed, has not been issued, or has failed all count)'.
evidence.R2-08: CO-S17-S23 Forbidden blocks (e.g. round0 lines 1027-1029) lack 'CO-A2 before the user's confirmation turn', and §5.1 'Events and effects' does not say whether 'exactly once, ... after the confirmation turn' counts the whole trial.
evidence.R2-09: CO-S17/S22/S23 step 6 'refund RF-5531, failed, card closed' (round0 lines 1045, 1336, 1394) survived the R1-16 removal of failure_reason from the Appendix A return shape.
evidence.R2-10: CO-05 allows CO-A3 for an order 'a lookup shows cancelled', and in CO-S06 the order is cancelled (line 405), so CO-05 does not underlie the Forbidden 'CO-A3 at any point' (line 427), yet Illustrates lists it (line 442).
evidence.R2-11: Packet line 54 'agent retries once, then re-reads ... and reports what it finds' and line 63 'after the retry the agent re-reads'; final spec row 111 re-reads only when the second CO-A3 is unanswered, and row 109 says 'has not been issued' when an answered retry returns failed.
evidence.R2-12: cockburn-checklist.md line 64 '...more than one plausible match, or none'; the round0 rows (lines 89-95) cover only a named number not on the account and a named order's status, and have none for no open order with no number named.
evidence.R2-13: Failure row 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' (round0 line 94) vs CO-S08 step 3 'asks whether they want to cancel the whole order' (line 540); 'propose' is undefined, though no verdict depends on it.
evidence.R3-01: CO-08 'the agent tells the customer the refund id' (final line 83) is enforced by the code grader 'Refund id reported' in 9 scenarios; the packet asks only to 'report that status' (line 63) and 'Final message must match the final refund status' (line 54).
evidence.R3-02: CO-07 (final line 80) calls for CO-A4 when an order is cancelled with no pending/issued refund, while the cancelled row (line 99) and packet line 72 say report and change nothing; CO-S06 tests only 'status issued', and CO-S23 leaves exactly the untested state.
evidence.R3-03: cockburn-checklist.md line 74 requires a 'nothing found' branch; round0 rows 100-101 branch only on cancelled/open/shipped/no answer, while CO-S24 treats a listed order coming back not found as possible.
evidence.R3-07: The quoted R1-12 fix counts the proposal only for the amount; CO-S09 row 4 (customer asks only about the amount) still required telling 'can go only to the order's payment method', which the final spec (line 1714) made conditional.
evidence.R3-08: §5.1 'A trial ends at the first agent message ... or at the agent's 12th message' plus Appendix A 'The agent may repeat CO-A1 without limit' leave the trial unbounded in CO-S10/S14/S15/S21, where every lookup goes unanswered; no line bounds tool calls.
evidence.R3-09: Final rows 98-99 cover only 'the named order, or the customer's only order when they named none', and CO-02 covers only more than one open order, so several orders with none open and no number named has no row (checklist line 64, 'or none').
evidence.R3-10: CO-03 requires both 'only the whole order' and 'the refund is the total paid ...' for partial-items requests, but round0 row 94 and 'Whole order only explained' (line 1501) carry only the first clause.
evidence.R3-11: Round0 row 89 'a lookup ... made before any CO-A2 | ... propose nothing' also matches a lookup after confirmation but before CO-A2, where 'propose nothing' no longer settles whether to make CO-A2.
evidence.R3-12: CO-S19 Forbidden 'Fewer than one CO-A1 after the second CO-A3' (round0 line 1141) states an absence and makes a read required, against evaluation-checklist.md lines 17 and 19.
